Welcome to the Sabiway API

The Sabiway API allows developers to build applications with access to authentication, user profiles, posts, notifications, and more.

Base URL: https://sabiway-9wq4.onrender.com/api

🔐 Authentication

Endpoints to handle user registration, login, logout, and token refresh.
